material.name: Al-7075-T6 example property set
material.provenance: Illustrative material properties for wrought 7075-T6 aluminum, chosen for this example: 62 ksi yield strength. 7075-T6 has no single minimum yield strength: it runs 54 to 73 ksi across product forms and thickness bands, so a figure quoted without a form and thickness is not a specification minimum. Not a design allowable, and not read from any material database.
